expectation: Membrane/cytoplasmic rings on almost all nucleated cells, so a broad stain. Brightest on immune and stromal cells. Some tumour nests may show patchy loss or reduced staining. Expect widespread outlines with a tissue-compartment pattern, not a rare subset.
observed: A: bright B2M across stroma and immune areas, with sharp dark tumour-nest islands in several cores. B: ring-like outlines around nuclei in stained bands next to unstained regions. C: dimmer, patchy cellular signal. D: a network of cell-outline rings.
why: The stain draws membrane outlines on most cells and drops out cleanly in some nests, which fits B2M's broad expression with loss on tumour cells, not haze or grain.
notes: B2M rings outline cells in stroma and immune-rich areas. Several cores have crisp dark nests, consistent with HLA-I/B2M loss on tumour cells. The edges are sharp and follow tissue compartments, not cell density alone.
